opening.argument: The presentation promotes an easy AVAX-earning method while directing viewers to deploy a contract, send approximately $200 in AVAX, and invoke a flash-loan function. Its title promises, “How To Earn AVAX Easily Using Flash loans Arbitrage On Metamask Works Perfectly,” while the speaker instructs viewers to “send over 11.23 AVAX” and claims, “We went $200 to. $1,775”. Those are concrete funding and high-return representations, not merely a discussion of trading risks. The available evidence does not verify the contract’s behavior, the recipient, the on-chain outcome, or that the claimed return was realized; the visible MetaMask panel only displays 11.23 AVAX. The personal-risk disclaimer qualifies the presentation, but does not remove the requested transfer or the prominent claim of substantially increased returns.
